annotations.title: Find a customer by your own id

description: WHITE LABEL: map YOUR OWN customer id (externalId) to the Hermoso brand you run for that customer, and look it up later. action get (default when externalId is given): the brand id and name, and what is connected on it (which platforms, which accounts, which need reconnecting). set: externalId + brand (default the current brand). list: every mapping. remove: drop a mapping (the brand is unchanged). A connect link created with externalId sets the mapping too. Act on the brand afterwards with use_brand. Free.

brand.description: the brand id (list_brands). set: the brand the id points at (default the current brand); list: only that brand's ids; get: refused unless the id is that brand's

externalId.description: your id for the customer: letters, digits and - _ . : @

name: manage_external_ids
